operationalization_across_methods: SWEET and DTW change identifiers; ACW (Guo), CodeTracer, and GDW apply functionality-preserving replacement; ACW (Li) uses GPT-4 to rename local variables and functions; MCGMark modifies identifiers within its micro-edit battery; ASLang applies lightweight renaming; CodeMark, SrcMarker, and CLASP rename 25/50/75/100% of variables; DWC uses 25/50/75%; MATRIX replaces identifiers randomly; MCSS renames 2/4/8/16/32 variables; RoSeMary and SWaRL use 10/30/50%.

ASLang evaluates formatting normalization and a mixed condition combining formatting, renaming, and comment removal; MATRIX reformats code with Black. MCSS proves formally (Theorem 5.3) that formatting affects zero watermark sites but runs no empirical formatting attack, so it is not counted.

MCGMark inserts comments, assignments, and redundant statements, modifies identifiers, I/O, comments, literals, and assignments, and removes modifiable elements across eight attacks; Code Acrostic excludes the natural-language comment carrier from the detection scope; ASLang removes comments; PromptMark randomly removes comments.

CodeMark applies RopGen transformation groups; ACW (Li) uses Ruff sets of 103 or 369 transformations; SrcMarker applies one to three MutableAST transformations; DWC applies one to three transformations, alone or combined with 50% renaming as a dual-channel attack; MATRIX uses Pyrefact and adds a combined dual-channel case study; MCSS perturbs each of eight structural channels individually; CLASP applies one to three random transformations.

SWEET uses CodePal AI Code Refactor; ACW (Guo) and CodeTracer use DIPPER; STONE uses CodePal and GPT-4o; CodeMark uses NatGen; MATRIX and CLASP use GPT-4o; MCSS evaluates five rewriting models at temperature 0.3 and top-p 0.95; RoSeMary uses Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct and DeepSeek-Coder-7B; SWaRL uses Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and DeepSeek-Coder-7B-Instruct; PromptMark uses GPT-Codex-5.3 with instructed variable renaming.
CodeIP removes 25% or 50% of the generated artifact; MCSS corrupts 10/20/30/40% of the reconstructed embedding sites.

ACW (Li) uses embedding-aware similarity analysis and a CodeT5+ 770M white-box de-watermarking model; CodeMark tests ONION recognition with CodeGPT substitution and white-box re-watermarking; SrcMarker and DWC train white- and black-box de-watermarking and re-watermarking models; RoSeMary re-watermarks with a surrogate model; CLASP uses GPT-4o with knowledge of the LLM-assisted setting but not of the private rules, original-code repository, or extractor.
